posts.title: Permission to leave it red
posts.description: When tests contradict requirements, another attempt cannot produce a correct implementation. Honest stopping gives an agent a way to hand back the conflict while the workflow keeps the task open.

posts.title: AI makes creative judgement more valuable
posts.description: Chess.com’s AI-assisted games expansion and Shortical’s licensed AI actor show different bets on automation in entertainment. For product builders, the editorial argues that production savings should fund distinctive experiences and creative judgement. (via The Verge)
